856-5776-7272-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another Food.
856-5776-7272-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

955-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

955-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
955-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

513-1003-3661.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-1003-3661.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

728-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
728-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

833-1059-1362-3827.notablePrerequisites: Grand Warlord Radha, Soul of Windgrace, and at least four additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-1362-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha, Soul of Windgrace, and at least four additional creatures as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Activate Oboro, Palace in the Clouds's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Oboro, Palace in the Clouds, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2557-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3110-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Council of the Absolute.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

2557-2757-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

348-1152-2992-5687-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-5687-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Skittering Precursor triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2173-5073-5220-6772.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3698-4668-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Heliod. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

582-1308-1409.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3504-5282-7149.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mercurial Pretender dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Mercurial Pretender enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mercurial Pretender leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mercurial Pretender from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3175-3605-4812-5256.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a film counter from it and tapping it, copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2060-2577-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2034-2060-2577-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

1580-2438-4871-5334.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2178-4147-4215-5147.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4215-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4147-4215-5147.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-3867-4231-4772-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
